rules.label: Only our lyrics are sung, as written
rules.target: no labels, directions or English in the sung sheet, and at least 90% of the brief's words kept

rules.label: Clear, unhurried singing
rules.target: at most 6.5 sung characters a second (Chota Sa Shiv Shambhu: 5.4) and the voice not buried (vocals at least -3 dB against the music)

rules.label: Chorus by 0:15
rules.target: first chorus starts by 0:15 (Gokul SEO guide)

rules.label: Final chorus is the biggest
rules.target: last chorus at least 0.5 dB above every earlier one

rules.label: Instruments drop out and return
rules.target: drums leave in at least 2 sections (AI tell 2-3)

rules.label: Choruses are not copies
rules.target: the chorus words change at least once (AI tell 11)

rules.label: No clipping
rules.target: true peak at or below -1 dBTP

listen: Pitch: is every note perfectly in tune (AI tell 14)?
Breaths: can you hear the singer breathe (12)?
Chord loop: does the bridge leave the home chords (4)?
Diction: same force on every line (10)?
